Tiệm Cà Phê Đồng Giao on 38 Hoàng Văn Thụ is one of those spots that looks closed until it isn't. 4.9 stars. 32 reviews. Every single one earned.

Under $10 a person. Coffee done right. No tourist markup, no English menu pressure.

If you're in Phu Quoc and need a real café morning, this is it. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
